name: 17516 · Conestoga, PA
findings: ZIP 17516 (Conestoga) has 17 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 17516 (Conestoga) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 17516 (Conestoga) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.
